General entry requirements and Mathematics 3b or 3c/Mathematics C
Knowledge corresponding to Molecular techniques and data analysis in precision medicine I (7.5hp 3MG038)

180 credits, from an internationally recognised university. The degree must be in biochemistry/chemistry, biology, biomedicine/medicine, biotechnology, bioinformatics, cell-/molecular biology, genetics, life science, medical sciences, pharmacy, or a similar field of study. Also required are courses in human genetics, cell biology and molecular biology totaling 30 credits including knowledge corresponding to Medical genetics and cancer - molecular mechanisms (3MG022 or 3MG030).

180 credits from educational programmes in biology, biomedicine/medicine, biotechnology, pharmacy, medical sciences, or a similar field of study. Also required are courses in cell biology, genetics, biochemistry and molecular biology. Also required is knowledge corresponding to Molecular Techniques and Data Analysis in Precision Medicine I 7.5 credits (3MG038), Introduction to machine learning and artificial intelligence for life sciences 7.5 credits (3FF041), Introduction to programming in R 7.5 credits (2ST133), and Biostatistics 7.5 credits (2ST134).
